**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

§ 18.1–18.2 (p0068–p0069) fully meet the preferred INSURANCE position:

| Playbook (preferred) | Contract |
|---|---|
| CGL 1M/occ, 2M agg | ✔ USD 1,000,000 / 2,000,000 |
| E&O 2M | ✔ USD 2,000,000 |
| Cyber/privacy 5M | ✔ USD 5,000,000 |
| Workers' comp per law | ✔ (plus employer's liability USD 1M) |
| Certificates on request | ✔ § 18.2 |

The clause also runs for the term plus one year, requires reputable insurers primary to our coverage, cancellation/material-reduction notice, and confirms insurance does not cap Vendor's liabilities. Nothing to negotiate here.
